scenario.topic: Select the destination for the graduation trip

options.name: Lakeview Mountain Resort
options.upside: Offers outdoor activities and lakeside views suitable for group bonding.
options.concern: Limited nightlife options and variable weather conditions.

options.name: Coastal City Beachfront

attrs.main_activities: beach sports, city tours, seafood dining

options.upside: Combines beach relaxation with urban entertainment and dining.
options.concern: Higher accommodation costs and potential crowds during peak season.

options.name: Historic Town Getaway
options.upside: Rich cultural experiences and manageable travel time.
options.concern: Less variety in outdoor activities and limited evening entertainment.

options.name: National Park Adventure

attrs.main_activities: wildlife watching, trail hiking, ranger programs

options.upside: Immersive nature experience with educational programs.
options.concern: Requires outdoor gear and may have limited cell service.

shared_context: A group of seven students is selecting a destination for their graduation trip. Each option must accommodate all participants, offer group-friendly activities, and be reachable within a 6-hour travel time from their city.

personas.name: Maya
personas.background: Maya is a 22-year-old environmental science student who enjoys urban culture and beach activities.
personas.private_goal: She wants a trip that balances relaxation with vibrant social scenes.

A.reason_for: Offers outdoor activities and lakeside views good for group bonding.
A.reason_against: Limited nightlife and weather could dampen fun.

B.reason_for: Combines beach relaxation with urban entertainment and dining, matching her social interests.

C.reason_for: Short travel time and cultural experiences are positive.
C.reason_against: Less variety in outdoor activities and limited nightlife don't appeal.

D.reason_for: Immersive nature and educational programs offer a refreshing change.
D.reason_against: Needs outdoor gear and limited cell service could be inconvenient.

personas.name: Liam
personas.background: Liam is a 23-year-old history major who values cultural immersion and efficient travel.
personas.private_goal: He wants a destination rich in history and easy to reach.

A.reason_for: Good group capacity and outdoor activities provide balance.
A.reason_against: Outdoor focus less aligned with his cultural interests.

B.reason_for: Offers urban entertainment and dining options.
B.reason_against: Longer travel time and crowds reduce appeal.

C.reason_for: Rich cultural experiences and short travel time fit his priorities.

D.reason_for: Educational ranger programs add cultural value.
D.reason_against: Outdoor gear requirement and cell service issues are concerns.

personas.name: Zoe
personas.background: Zoe is a 21-year-old avid hiker and nature lover who enjoys group outdoor adventures.
personas.private_goal: She wants an active trip with plenty of hiking and nature exploration.

A.reason_for: Hiking, boating, and campfires perfectly match her outdoor interests.

B.reason_for: Beach sports offer some outdoor activity.
B.reason_against: Urban focus and crowds detract from nature experience.

C.reason_against: Lacks outdoor activities and nature immersion.

D.reason_for: Wildlife watching and hiking align well with her interests.
D.reason_against: Needs outdoor gear and limited connectivity could be inconvenient.

personas.name: Eli
personas.background: Eli is a 24-year-old creative writing student who enjoys storytelling and quiet nature escapes.
personas.private_goal: He wants a peaceful setting to relax and reflect with friends.

A.reason_for: Lakeside views and campfires provide a calm, inspiring environment.

B.reason_for: Urban entertainment is interesting but less aligned with his preference.

C.reason_against: Limited outdoor activities might feel restrictive.

D.reason_for: Immersive nature and ranger programs provide peaceful engagement.
D.reason_against: Limited cell service could be isolating.

personas.name: Nina
personas.background: Nina is a 22-year-old art history enthusiast who appreciates cultural festivals and easy travel.
personas.private_goal: She wants a destination rich in culture with manageable travel time.

A.reason_for: Outdoor activities offer a nice break from city life.
A.reason_against: Limited nightlife and weather concerns lower enthusiasm.

B.reason_for: Beach and city activities are appealing but cost is a concern.

C.reason_for: Rich cultural experiences and local festivals match her interests.

D.reason_for: Nature and educational programs add variety.
D.reason_against: Outdoor gear requirement and connectivity issues are drawbacks.

personas.name: Omar
personas.background: Omar is a 23-year-old social media enthusiast who enjoys lively environments and sharing experiences online.
personas.private_goal: He wants a destination with active nightlife and photogenic spots.

A.reason_for: Outdoor activities are nice but not ideal for social media content.

B.reason_for: Urban entertainment and beach activities provide great content and social scenes.

C.reason_against: Cultural focus and limited nightlife reduce excitement.

D.reason_for: Nature and ranger programs offer unique content opportunities.
D.reason_against: Limited cell service could hinder posting.

personas.name: Ivy
personas.background: Ivy is a 22-year-old biology student passionate about wildlife and outdoor education.
personas.private_goal: She wants a trip centered on nature and learning experiences.

A.reason_for: Hiking and boating offer good nature interaction.
A.reason_against: Limited educational programs compared to National Park.

B.reason_for: Beach sports provide some outdoor activity.
B.reason_against: Urban focus and crowds detract from nature immersion.

D.reason_for: Wildlife watching and ranger programs align perfectly with her interests.
